LanguageData.RR_BedsideRoleNotReady: The role holder must be awake, conscious and able to speak in their bed, with this role ability available.
LanguageData.RR_BedsideRoleBusy: A participant is already reserved or attending a bedside session.
LanguageData.RR_BedsideRoleRecipientBusy: The visitor is busy with work that cannot be interrupted for this visit.
LanguageData.RR_BedsideRoleNoContact: The visitor needs a reachable place beside this bed. Two immobile occupants must already be within reach and sight.
LanguageData.RR_BedsideRoleBlocked: The bed or its occupant is reserved for another activity.
LanguageData.RR_BedsideRitualSite: Place an appropriate ritual spot or ideology building within four cells of the bed, in the same room and with a clear line of sight. The role holder must be awake and able to speak.
LanguageData.RR_BedsideRitualEscort: A prisoner needs an available mobile warden to escort them to the bedside ritual.
LanguageData.RR_BedsideRitualLocalTarget: A pawn in a mental state must already be within speaking distance of this bed for a trial.
LanguageData.RR_BedsideRitualEscortNotNeeded: An escort is only needed for a prisoner.
